description: Show one maviapi API's endpoints: what each returns, its parameters (required ones marked), the fields in the response, and whether each endpoint is working right now. Also lists endpoints that are being built. Accepts the API slug from search_apis, or the site's domain (e.g. "airbnb.com"). Read this before call_api. If the API lacks what you need, request_endpoint adds an endpoint to it.

api.description: API slug (e.g. "booking") or the site's domain.
